name: Darius
summary: Darius the Median took the kingdom after Belshazzar and made Daniel one of his top leaders. Talked into a law that sent Daniel to the lions, he saw God rescue Daniel and told all nations to fear Daniel's God.

key_moments.title: Taking the Kingdom
key_moments.description: Darius took the kingdom at about sixty-two years old. He set 120 princes over it, with three presidents above them, and Daniel was first among them.

key_moments.title: Signing the Decree
key_moments.description: Leaders who could find no fault in Daniel asked Darius to sign a law that for thirty days no one could pray to any god or man but the king. Darius signed it, and it could not be changed.

key_moments.title: A Sleepless Night
key_moments.description: Darius tried until sunset to save Daniel but had to let him be thrown to the lions. He fasted and could not sleep, then hurried to the den at dawn and found Daniel alive.

key_moments.title: A Decree for Daniel's God
key_moments.description: King Darius wrote to all people that they must tremble and fear before Daniel's God, the living God who had saved Daniel from the lions.
